name: Gravitational & Space Cell Biology
summary: How cells, microbes, plants and animals sense gravity and respond to microgravity and space conditions.

topics.name: Gravity sensing in cells and organisms
Microgravity simulation: clinostats, random positioning machines and drop towers
Cell biology in microgravity: cytoskeleton, gene expression and signaling
Microbial behaviour in space: virulence, biofilms and antibiotic resistance
Plant growth in space: gravitropism, root orientation and seed-to-seed experiments
Animal development and reproduction in space
Model organisms flown in space and key experiments
Space omics: NASA GeneLab and the space omics databases
